lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly three horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, displaying a roughly equidistant spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like pattern where the highest-intensity blobs reside within the vertical band boundaries.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient showing peak luminance on the dorsal edge transitioning to shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density distribution of significantly smaller punctate spots is present on the head region, anterior to the larger lateral flank pattern.
